One major component that was missed. 

 

Since it was not entire down payment. Owner even saved on interest. Had I put 14.5L in bank for 2 years at 7% interest I would get. 2L interest. 

 

For 4L ask on lease transfer owner has a profit of 30K ??

 

If you buy a car by paying entire amount that is 14.5L with a deprecation of 30% over 2 years its resell value will be 10.15.

Buyer also lost on interest opportunity that he would have got had he put that amount in bank(7% per anum)

So net loss to buyer will 14.5 -10.15 + 2 = 6.35L

 

For lease transfer With no extra ask loss is just 3.7L.  that is like 2.7L less with no hassles of vehicle transfer. 

 

I am just not convinced at lease transfer ask 

 

Well you can bend the calculation in any way but I would always bias it towards buyer because he is the one who will pay lease transfer amount.

 

Regards

-Anirudha

Subject: RE: ESPP and Taxation
Body:
Tax is calculated on market price of purchase date and sale date. 

 

The discount we are getting is already taxed in form16. You can see ESPP perquisite in tax computation sheet of eypayroll site.

 

Assume you got 50K worth stocks you will be buying them for 45K the remaining 5K is added in ESPP perquisite and taxed in regular payroll. So indirectly/directly we are paying tax  for the 10% discount we are getting.

 

For the 1st question oneâ€™s taxable income doesnâ€™t reduce. For ESPP the money is deducted from payroll after calculating tax.

It is like salary came to our account after tax deduction. And then money from our account is deducted for ESPP.

I am living there. It's very good.

It was best when I moved in there 3 years back. There were very less people living there at that time.

Nobody follows parking rules. You can park your car anywhere you want if your parking place is occupied by someone or if it is far.

On Fridays and Saturdays a few people celebrate and I like it knowing they are happy.

I used to go for morning walk where there are peacocks and rabbits there at the back of the society. A few people who are concerned about wild animals broke beer and whisky bottles on the road. I accepted my mistake to not disturb wildlife and stopped going that side.

Itâ€™s a place built by Mr. and Mrs. Torane where the orphan kinds and the children of the migrant workers are taken care as a family. A couple Mr. Sakharam (retired teacher) and Mrs. Ramabai Torane (Anganwadi worker) have spent all their belongings to set up this ashram. Initially the count of kids was 5-6 but now it has crossed 50. During the season when bulk migration of local labors happen this count reaches to even 80. The daily expenses are met by Ramabaiâ€™s Anganwadi salary and from Sakharamâ€™s pension. However the struggle of facing each day with big smiles hasnâ€™t faded yet. E.g. These kids donâ€™t have enough space to sleep so they have to adjust a lot. 

 

Sunrise Pratishthan is closely working with them since last several months. After assessing their pressing needs we decided to build a new room and install solar system in ashram. Subject: RE: Help needed for Passport renew process
Body:
Simple process. 

 

Create profile in passportindia.gov.in : with setting â€œRegister to apply at passport officeâ€ : Hyderabad. (Since yours could be 10 years old passport you may not have existing profile in this site). 

Create new application for Reissue of passport

And feed in all info. Make sure you enter the previous file number and passport number correctly. Plus make sure your current address proof looks exactly as you type in the application. 

Submit application and select nearest psk for appointment. 

 

In psk <Mine was tolychowki> 

: Section a> take finger prints/photos and scan docs. : section b:\verify name/address/docs (again).. : Section C : final approval section will verify your name/address exact/preciseness and your father name/dob etc. 

Total time : 40 mins to 1 hour tops. 

Be there at psk 15/30 mins ahead of time. 

Keep the application papers that psk returns to you during appointment the police verification guy will take it with him when he visits for address/id verification. 

 

The entire process should not take more then a week (mine finished in 5 days from application submission to getting my passport at home). Prior passport address Mumbai. 

 

Regards

m

From another DL for everybodyâ€™s awareness.

 

 

Watch out for this phish. The email spelling of my friend was wrong. They  asked for my password which I did not give them.

Phishing attempts and weird WeTransfer imitations

Here's a checklist to see if you're communicating with our service or people pretending to be us (which will be referred to as "the phishers" from here on out) with the intention of stealing your login details or installing malware on your machine.

*        Is the layout different from the layout you usually see when you open a WeTransfer mail? If so don't use the download button or link.

*        Does the download button take you to our domain (https://wetransfer.com <https://na01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwetransfer.com&data=04%7C01%7Ctgriffin%40microsoft.com%7C743171d6cf3d4c4c875408d58a9a6b6e%7C72f988bf86f141af91ab2d7cd011db47%7C1%7C0%7C636567318193782139%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwifQ%3D%3D%7C-1&sdata=xWMoCWChyJ987PyiJRJyWUtO6ba2IVmG%2FsWNvjqHmyA%3D&reserved=0> )? If not the files are hosted somewhere else and never safe to download.

*        Check the address mentioned in the body of the email. If the transfer isn't from someone you know or an obvious fake don't use the download link.

*        Check the sender's address. We always send our emails from "...@wetransfer.com <mailto:...@wetransfer.com> ". If the email is sent from a different address don't open the download link.

*        Please note that emails from "...@wetransfer.com <mailto:...@wetransfer.com> " are no guarantee that weâ€™ve actually sent you this email. So stay aware even if we seem to be the sender.

*        Check the address the email was sent to. We only ever send a transfer email to your own email address. Not to "undisclosed recipients" or to other addresses. So finding a "Bcc" definitely means we did not send you this email. 

Do not log in / enter your credentials or click the download link in a suspicious 'transfer' email.

@Kajol Kardam <mailto:kajoka@microsoft.com> 

I ran into the exact same issue for MSFTVPN  by looking at the trouble shooting manual and working with the tech link assistance it now works seamlessly.

 

Here is what I did:

*	My certificates were expired â€“ carry your card with you and the Tech link folks will update that for you.
*	Missing BIOS and OS updates.
*	This is the most important part  run a ping test against msft.vpn.ras.microsoft.com 

	*	I noticed that MSFTVPN only fails on my home connection which uses ACT broadband.
	*	ACT lately have been pushing to use only their DNS servers  but with a bit of tweaking you can update this to either google DNS or Open DNS
	*	Turns out that msftnpm.ras.microsoft.com resolves to a bunch of URLs which represent microsoft edge servers (Entry point servers to microsoft servers  like Cloudflare is to AWS)  these edge server URLs are further converted into IP addresses before your machine actually initiates the VPN connection protocols.
	*	While the DNS records for msftvpn.ras.microsoft.com is present in most DNS systems the DNS records for the edge servers are present in few ISP owned DNS systems. This means they would have to reach global DNS servers which takes time and eventually times out. 
	*	I updated the DNS addressed and it connected seamlessly to portal. 

*	At the end I think the evidence was right in front of our eyes â€œCould not connect to portalâ€ aka they could not find an IP address to ping. 

 

Hope this helps  let me know if turns out to be a different problem all together which is quite possible since this is MSFTVPN ?? . 

 

Regards

Hector

@Kajol Kardam <mailto:kajoka@microsoft.com> 

I ran into the exact same issue for MSFTVPN  by looking at the trouble shooting manual and working with the tech link assistance it now works seamlessly.

 

Here is what I did:

*	My certificates were expired â€“ carry your card with you and the Tech link folks will update that for you.
*	Missing BIOS and OS updates.
*	This is the most important part  run a ping test against msft.vpn.ras.microsoft.com 

	*	I noticed that MSFTVPN only fails on my home connection which uses ACT broadband.
	*	ACT lately have been pushing to use only their DNS servers  but with a bit of tweaking you can update this to either google DNS or Open DNS
	*	Turns out that msftnpm.ras.microsoft.com resolves to a bunch of URLs which represent microsoft edge servers (Entry point servers to microsoft servers  like Cloudflare is to AWS)  these edge server URLs are further converted into IP addresses before your machine actually initiates the VPN connection protocols.
	*	While the DNS records for msftvpn.ras.microsoft.com is present in most DNS systems the DNS records for the edge servers are present in few ISP owned DNS systems. This means they would have to reach global DNS servers which takes time and eventually times out. 
	*	I updated the DNS addressed and it connected seamlessly to portal. 

*	At the end I think the evidence was right in front of our eyes â€œCould not connect to portalâ€ aka they could not find an IP address to ping. 

 

Hope this helps  let me know if turns out to be a different problem all together which is quite possible since this is MSFTVPN ?? .

Subject: Awareness - PCI details shared over paper/email for official taxi services at Hyderabad
Body:
FYI team â€“ looks like the process of collecting PCI data over paper/emails continue to exist - for services procured from vendors on campus eg. airport pickup and drop for business travels

 

Just wanted to share my experience and it may help the new joinees/freshers on campus

 

Domestic Hyd transport request experience:

 

Travel Request:

*	Log your airport pick up and drop requests for your business travel on this site <https://aka.ms/hydtransport>  mentioning your preferred mode of payment (I had chosen Amex) 
*	Your request would be acknowledged and assigned to vendors (Noori 24X7 translines etc.) by the transport desk team. 
*	Am not sure of the logic of the vendor assignment (random or round-robin) since I got assigned to Noori for my onward journey and 24x7 Translines for return
*	Transport desk shares all the data we provide in the request directly with the vendor through an email to an external email address

	*	Name corporate email ID contact number â€“ PII (Personally identifiable Information)
	*	Flight details and the dates â€“ necessary for the requested services

 

During travel:

Subject: RE: Awareness - PCI details shared over paper/email for official taxi services at Hyderabad
Body:
I totally echo on Aravindâ€™s point on not sharing Amex Card Details. Never Ever Share Amex card details.

 

I want to narrate an incident that happened with me with regards to Amex Card.

 

Four years back when I joined Microsoft as a part of relocation benefit company provided me a Hotel Accommodation. By the time my relocation period exhausted I still hadnâ€™t received my Amex Card.

Hotel management suggested that I can pay it when I receive my Amex Card. It took couple of weeks to procure my Amex Card. During that period I received calls from the Hotel to repay my Bill.

Once I received my Amex card I contacted the Hotel and informed that I would settle the Bill in person. However the Hotel management offered that they could settle the transaction on my behalf if I quote the Amex Card Number.

I believe they have a provision where they could clear a transaction without the need for the PIN. So the bill got settled and hotel personal came to office and handed over the Bill.

 

After 2 years I noticed a swipe transaction for Rs5000/- made from my Amex card which didnâ€™t involve me. I contacted the Amex customer care and informed that â€œItâ€™s a false transaction and I never swipedâ€. I received the transaction details from them regarding where it was swiped.

Unfortunately it was same hotel where I stayed in during my relocation period. I had never visited that hotel again post my relocation. I contacted the Hotel owner and narrated him the entire incident. Initially he was reluctant however on insisting 

he agreed to investigate and revert. The Hotel management ensured an internal enquiry and then it came in to light that the staff who had collected my Amex card details two years back had swiped it and collected Rs5000/- as cash from the guest who was checking out from the Hotel and replaced that 5000/- cash with Amex receipt!! 

 

So henceforth be cautious and never share your Amex Card details.

 

Thanks & Regards

Bharath

FYI team â€“ looks like the process of collecting PCI data over paper/emails continue to exist - for services procured from vendors on campus eg. airport pickup and drop for business travels

 

Just wanted to share my experience and it may help the new joinees/freshers on campus

 

Domestic Hyd transport request experience:

 

Travel Request:

*	Log your airport pick up and drop requests for your business travel on this site <https://aka.ms/hydtransport>  mentioning your preferred mode of payment (I had chosen Amex) 
*	Your request would be acknowledged and assigned to vendors (Noori 24X7 translines etc.) by the transport desk team. 
*	Am not sure of the logic of the vendor assignment (random or round-robin) since I got assigned to Noori for my onward journey and 24x7 Translines for return
*	Transport desk shares all the data we provide in the request directly with the vendor through an email to an external email address

	*	Name corporate email ID contact number â€“ PII (Personally identifiable Information)
	*	Flight details and the dates â€“ necessary for the requested services

 

During travel:

*	The driver has all your data printed/typed out in the form he holds and you are requested to write in your credit card details in clear text on the forms (!)
*	Since I had chosen the Amex card payment option during the request I declined to write the card details and asked the driver to inform his operations
*	Name address corporate EmailID contact number etc. - Already provided PII in the physical format (paper) is with the driver
*	An unassuming employee may potentially provide his/her Amex card number to be written into the physical paper form that the driver holds â€“ Please DO NOT provide your card details there

 

Post travel:

*	Noori sends out an email containing the invoice receipt and an URL for the payment through their website. Their payment gateway is facilitated by ccavenue over https.
*	24x7 Translines sends out an email containing the invoice receipt and asks for the employee to reply with the sensitive card details in email to their external email address â€“ Please DO NOT provide your card details over email to external alias

	*	Decline to provide the card details over email to external alias and request them instead to share their website for payment or respective bank details to do an online transfer
	*	24X7 would then share their bank details â€“ problem here is though an employee must go through the process of registering their account as payee before performing an online transfer
	*	Alternately we should request transport desk to assign the services to Noori travels since they have a better workflow for the payment as listed above â€“ Note: This may indirectly reduce business for 24X7 and make them comply with a better payment workflow

 

Letâ€™s try to take than one small moment to pause before we share our details in a land where there isnâ€™t stricter data privacy laws. Hopefully the vendor services procurement team would take a note of this and drive the vendors comply to consistent data sharing and security controls while providing services to Microsoft.

 

Thanks

Aravind

Subject: RE: Maintenance charges
Body:
This is just my personal opinion especially there in no one single approach. You put out one logic and then you will have equal counter.

 

On High level:

 

1.	Area Independent Usage of Facilities : Use of facilities is like swimming pool club security etc doesnâ€™t depend on how big and small your apartment is.
2.	Area Dependent Usage of Facilities: Maintenance BackUp Water depends on size of your apartment . For ex: the bigger is your house the probability of its maintenance is much higher than small house. So and so forth.

 

Common Variable: Number of members in the family applies to #1 and #2. So it can be taken out.

Assumption: People will bigger flats have bigger purse ?? . That doesnâ€™t mean they will take all the burden but nevertheless a fact

 

So folks believe in uniform charge are countered by #2 and folks believe in size based charge are countered by #1.

 

So what do we do? In lieu not having a full proof solution ( like many other problems in life)..I would say size based maintenance is good ( best of the available options) and then make certain other components usage based ( like putting meter of water  amount of back up electricity consumption etc. but canâ€™t include swimming pool gym etc. Those will remain grey. 

 

Thanks
Debjit

Agree with Uday on Sundaram being more expensive and having their emi-s changing though I found that the interest charges are quite high with Clix charging @12.49% (as calculated below) and Sundaram being even more expensive. Same loan could be availed outside ~ @9% but as the deduction wonâ€™t be applicable on outside loans so overall it is less expensive also in comparison to paying the entire amount as lumpsum. Not sure about why the interest rates are higher and not lower in comparison to outside loans. One other thing I noticed that if we decide to pay the whole amount earlier then not only the interest would be applied on the whole sum for the complete tenure but also there would be additional â€œforeclosure penalty chargesâ€ of around 1% on top for clearing the debt earlier!

 

Clix rates from portal




Interest rate calculation (assuming the loan amount to be Rs. 1000 to calculate PTPM)

 

Tenor (in months) (A)

36

Residual value (in %) (B)

20%

interest rate annually C

12.49%

		
Loaned amount (D)

1000

Residual amount  E = B * D

200

		
PTPM = PMT(C/12 A -D E 0)

? 28.84

		
PMT(rate nper pv [fv] [type])

	
		
rate : interest rate

	
nper : total number of payments

	
pv : The present value or the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now

	
fv : The future value or a cash balance you want to attain after the last payment is made.

	
type  : 0 or 1 and indicates when payments are due.

3.	Lower interest rates in outside loan can be compensated by the savings (tax on EMI & Maintenance) if you stay for more than half of the lease tenure.

Agree with Uday on Sundaram being more expensive and having their emi-s changing though I found that the interest charges are quite high with Clix charging @12.49% (as calculated below) and Sundaram being even more expensive. Same loan could be availed outside ~ @9% but as the deduction wonâ€™t be applicable on outside loans so overall it is less expensive also in comparison to paying the entire amount as lumpsum. Not sure about why the interest rates are higher and not lower in comparison to outside loans. One other thing I noticed that if we decide to pay the whole amount earlier then not only the interest would be applied on the whole sum for the complete tenure but also there would be additional â€œforeclosure penalty chargesâ€ of around 1% on top for clearing the debt earlier!

 

Clix rates from portal




Interest rate calculation (assuming the loan amount to be Rs. 1000 to calculate PTPM)

 

Tenor (in months) (A)

36

Residual value (in %) (B)

20%

interest rate annually C

12.49%

		
Loaned amount (D)

1000

Residual amount  E = B * D

200

		
PTPM = PMT(C/12 A -D E 0)

? 28.84

		
PMT(rate nper pv [fv] [type])

	
		
rate : interest rate

	
nper : total number of payments

	
pv : The present value or the total amount that a series of future payments is worth now

	
fv : The future value or a cash balance you want to attain after the last payment is made.

	
type  : 0 or 1 and indicates when payments are due.

Subject: Ford FreeStyle ---> Quick note , If you are looking for a hatchback, worth waiting for the launch
Body:
Hi

 

I got a chance to test-drive the FreeStyle in a pre-launch invite. 

 

Thought of sharing my experience with wider group as this is having the capabilities of a Small SUV and drives like a hatchback. On top of that it has the best ride and handling under 10 lakhs .. The new dragon series engine is also a big all-rounder. 

 

Copy pasting the review which I put in team-bhp.

 

FreeStyle The driving experience 

I happened to drive both Petrol and Diesel. 

Letâ€™s start with the common things first. The front is really appealing and have a good road presence whereas side and back profile doesn't have much changes. When you get in to the car it is a welcome move and the first attraction is the Touch screen. The clarity/brightness and responsiveness are as same as the big brothers' Ecosport and Endeavour. (This supports Android auto and Apple Car Play). The start stop button is also designed in a neat and clean way. The Brown and Black Dashboard looks good to me. For me this was better plastic than the plastic that is there in Ecosport. (But still I love the soft touch material which was there in the Second Generation Fiesta Classic). The A/C is fantastic. The day when I was test driving the outside temperature was more than 40 degrees the cabin got cooled down (The car was in the sun for quite a long time) within 5-7 minutes (Including the back). The new front seats are supportive But the under thigh support is less for me. (It could be because of my height as well  for reference I am 6'3"). Now coming to the back side the seat appeared to be wider than the sibling Figo. When I adjusted the driver seat to my height I could easily sit in the rear. If I extend my legs beneath the front seat then my shins were touching the scooping of the front seat. But I think that for a 6 feet taller person this should not be a problem. The Headroom is also decent but because of the fixed head rest the head rest was touching my shoulders (Not even the neck). Coming to the other features the sound system is ok not that good of what is there in EcoSport. Passenger seatbelt reminder is there which is a welcome move. Sync 3 is also another good point. The seating position is not as commanding as when you sit in an Ecosport but much better than Figo. 

(Drove for around 100 KM) But letâ€™s start with Petrol as it is the new Engine with the new Gearbox. We started the test drive from the packed city traffic of Hyderabad and I was pleasant to see the way the car was pulling in 10 KMPH in second gear. Without any knocking or vibration the car was moving smoothly in very slow speed in second gear. That means the frequent Gear shift is not needed at all for city drive. As an icing on the cake the clutch is superb light. The second point to be noted is the NVH levels I felt the NVH levels are better than Figo and Aspire. Being a 3 Cylinder engine I was expecting some clatter in idling but it was not at all there. Only thing which may be evident because of the 3 pot engine is the idling RPM it was hovering around 1000 compared to 4 pots where it would be around 750. 

The other positive finding was the suspension. With 5 people on-board the suspension was much better compared to the siblings Figo And Aspire. The small speed breakers and potholes were swallowed very easily compared to EcoSport. (Which throws you out from the rear seat ). If the vehicle is loaded only with Driver and / or passenger then it becomes a little rubbery too. But when the car gets more speed the ride becomes really great. 

After almost a half an hour city drive we took the car to the express way of Hyderabad Outer Ring Road. We wanted to test the capability of the new engine. The Engine is very responsive up to 3 digit speeds the engine pulls with lot of easiness and the power delivery is also linear. In second gear I could able to go up to 80KMPH without even reaching anywhere near the red line and in third gear three digit speeds achieved without any stress feeling on the engine. That means overtaking on highways will be an easy task. The power delivery is linear till 4500 RPM and after that it flattens out. The other good point for driving enthusiast is that in high speed the car gets planted very well and you will not feel uncomfortable or unsecured. The car handles very well. The steering is very light in slow speed and stationary and it gets heavier as the speed takes up and the feedback is also good. The straight line stability of the car also was good. No complain. So I felt another good drivers car in the offering. 

Coming to the Diesel as it is the same old engine doing the duty in all the other Ford Cars there is no special point to be mentioned other than NVH levels I think the NVH levels have improved to a great extent compared to Figo and Aspire. In idling and city drive the cabin was so silent for Diesel

To sum it up Ford has a winner in the cards if they price it well. And for driving enthusiast we have a good drivers car in pipeline. Drivers will enjoy this car for sure.

 

 

Thanks

 

Anumod

Subject: Ford FreeStyle ---> Quick note  If you are looking for a hatchback worth waiting for the launch
Importance: Low

 

Hi

 

I got a chance to test-drive the FreeStyle in a pre-launch invite. 

 

Thought of sharing my experience with wider group as this is having the capabilities of a Small SUV and drives like a hatchback. On top of that it has the best ride and handling under 10 lakhs .. The new dragon series engine is also a big all-rounder. 

 

Copy pasting the review which I put in team-bhp.

 

FreeStyle The driving experience 

I happened to drive both Petrol and Diesel. 

Letâ€™s start with the common things first. The front is really appealing and have a good road presence whereas side and back profile doesn't have much changes. When you get in to the car it is a welcome move and the first attraction is the Touch screen. The clarity/brightness and responsiveness are as same as the big brothers' Ecosport and Endeavour. (This supports Android auto and Apple Car Play). The start stop button is also designed in a neat and clean way. The Brown and Black Dashboard looks good to me. For me this was better plastic than the plastic that is there in Ecosport. (But still I love the soft touch material which was there in the Second Generation Fiesta Classic). The A/C is fantastic. The day when I was test driving the outside temperature was more than 40 degrees the cabin got cooled down (The car was in the sun for quite a long time) within 5-7 minutes (Including the back). The new front seats are supportive But the under thigh support is less for me. (It could be because of my height as well  for reference I am 6'3"). Now coming to the back side the seat appeared to be wider than the sibling Figo. When I adjusted the driver seat to my height I could easily sit in the rear. If I extend my legs beneath the front seat then my shins were touching the scooping of the front seat. But I think that for a 6 feet taller person this should not be a problem. The Headroom is also decent but because of the fixed head rest the head rest was touching my shoulders (Not even the neck). Coming to the other features the sound system is ok not that good of what is there in EcoSport. Passenger seatbelt reminder is there which is a welcome move. Sync 3 is also another good point. The seating position is not as commanding as when you sit in an Ecosport but much better than Figo. 

(Drove for around 100 KM) But letâ€™s start with Petrol as it is the new Engine with the new Gearbox. We started the test drive from the packed city traffic of Hyderabad and I was pleasant to see the way the car was pulling in 10 KMPH in second gear. Without any knocking or vibration the car was moving smoothly in very slow speed in second gear. That means the frequent Gear shift is not needed at all for city drive. As an icing on the cake the clutch is superb light. The second point to be noted is the NVH levels I felt the NVH levels are better than Figo and Aspire. Being a 3 Cylinder engine I was expecting some clatter in idling but it was not at all there. Only thing which may be evident because of the 3 pot engine is the idling RPM it was hovering around 1000 compared to 4 pots where it would be around 750. 

The other positive finding was the suspension. With 5 people on-board the suspension was much better compared to the siblings Figo And Aspire. The small speed breakers and potholes were swallowed very easily compared to EcoSport. (Which throws you out from the rear seat ). If the vehicle is loaded only with Driver and / or passenger then it becomes a little rubbery too. But when the car gets more speed the ride becomes really great. 

After almost a half an hour city drive we took the car to the express way of Hyderabad Outer Ring Road. We wanted to test the capability of the new engine. The Engine is very responsive up to 3 digit speeds the engine pulls with lot of easiness and the power delivery is also linear. In second gear I could able to go up to 80KMPH without even reaching anywhere near the red line and in third gear three digit speeds achieved without any stress feeling on the engine. That means overtaking on highways will be an easy task. The power delivery is linear till 4500 RPM and after that it flattens out. The other good point for driving enthusiast is that in high speed the car gets planted very well and you will not feel uncomfortable or unsecured. The car handles very well. The steering is very light in slow speed and stationary and it gets heavier as the speed takes up and the feedback is also good. The straight line stability of the car also was good. No complain. So I felt another good drivers car in the offering. 

Coming to the Diesel as it is the same old engine doing the duty in all the other Ford Cars there is no special point to be mentioned other than NVH levels I think the NVH levels have improved to a great extent compared to Figo and Aspire. In idling and city drive the cabin was so silent for Diesel

To sum it up Ford has a winner in the cards if they price it well. And for driving enthusiast we have a good drivers car in pipeline. Drivers will enjoy this car for sure.

 

 

Thanks

 

Anumod

Body:
Looking for a chilled out woman preferably someone who is into music and loves listening to Rock songs.

The society has a great clubhouse with all sorts of amenities including Swimming pool Gymnasium Squash Court Table tennis with plenty of open space to roam around and have a nice and peaceful walk.

Thank You!

Bipasha

Just thought of sharing my experience of this Dr as it may help some ..

 

Found out before the surgery itself that Dr E C Vinay Kumar has a lot of social commitments and he runs a charitable organization to help kids who has hearing issues by birth and help them to have Cochlea Implant (which is worth 8.5 lakhs) for free. He runs a speech Therapy Centre in Apollo for these Kids to come to the normal life which may go for 1-2 years. (That is also for free). Till now he and his team have done the implant on 300+ kids for free. He was one of the major master mind to have Govt to come up with Arogyasri scheme. 

 

Now coming to my experience I felt that he was very knowledgeable and very down to earth. In the surgery procedures the bill has come with a 50% discount and room rent has come with a 10% discount (Even though mine was through Insurance and cashless )and when I checked at the billing counter the executive said that this Dr does always do like this.  I have done 3 follow-up visits in one month after the surgery and all of them were free. 

 

Only one thing I have to point out This Dr is very busy all days as he does lot of major surgery so if you take an OP appointment you may not be able to see him in the time slot given to you. Papers and posters will go through a review process by a highly competent panel of experts. Authors of selected papers and posters will have the opportunity to present it to an IDC wide community. Relevant topics for the SYNAPSE -2018  include but are not limited to the following areas:

The paper must contain a well-defined problem system description (overview and architecture) evaluation metrics and results and summary of the impact. The papers are not limited to completely original scientific ideas and authors are encouraged to share their case studies user experiences and application papers describing applications of known ideas to solve complex problems.

Subject: Re: Anyone tried vehicle registration @ RTO Kondapur without agent
Body:
Hi

I tried vehicle registration for company car without agent and i was successful.

The process is :-


1.	You need to book an online slot on https://tgtransport.net/TGCFSTONLINE/OnlineTransactions/RegSlot.aspx
	
2.	Take printout of slot confirmation and take all the papers required for registration with you.
3.	Submit the document at one of the window and person there will verify the documents and if all are correct he will send it for further processing.
4.	Then in another window they will give you a confirmation slip and take that slip to have photo(your photo). Photo will be taken then and there only.
5.	After that take all documents and bring your vehicle from parking to police office sitting nearby for inspection. You will read the chasis number and he will verify and you are done.
6.	After 2-3 days you will get SMS for number plate affixation and you need to take car there to affix number plate.

The Day 1 process takes ~3 hours and Number plate affixation takes 1 hour.


If you are looking for some special number i.e sum of digits sums up to a number then you need to make draft of Rs 1000 in favor of Secretary Regional Transport Authority RANGA REDDY.


Daily there are ~250 numbers allotted and they put up a list there. This Rs 1000 is for you can choose a number from that list and give a preference there. You also need to fill a form to apply for that. below is the form link.
http://www.aptransport.org/html/pdf/form-RRMA.pdf


Along with the form you need to take printout of all the documents and attach with the form and apply on Day 1. 
Documents for special number they only take after 12 or 1 pm.

And if you want a VVIP number then you can read this document last page for the procedure.
http://transport.telangana.gov.in/reservation_pdf_uploads/RANGAREDDY1527647871.pdf


~Ishan

w.r.t Vodafone

Had the call quality problems last year in October months back and this started when I moved from 2G to 3G. 

 

My understanding is this - actually they donâ€™t 3G and internally they try to switch to Idea cellular (Voda already bought Idea long back) and that is the root of the problem however they did not accept that fact during conversations. But I was sure and for verification you can change your phone settings to 2G and then phone will again work awesome (in terms of signal strength).

 

So later I took to Jio and converted my Vodafone 3g postpaid to Vodafone pre-paid 2g (without data). However internet data work awesome on 2G/3G on Vodafone. It is just that call signal goes bad when we move to voda 3G.

 

Jio â€“ Happy with internet speed.. However call signal strength for depends on Area (in B-2 it works at few place and many places not but helpful during my travel).

 

In Summary â€“ Call is best with Vodafone (only with their 2g- also called normal DONâ€™T opt for 3g on sim and please donâ€™t use their 3g internet it is worst with 3g 2g is perfect). You can rely on Jio for internet. My best solution was have dual sim (Voda â€“ prepaid (Ensure to disable all add-ons and register in DnD â€“ vodaâ€™s customer care helps in the same) + Jio) and I am satisfied with the combination from last 6 months.

 

I have Airtel Broadband at home. But never used their sim for calls (but their quality is degrading slowly Many of my friends have told the same)

 

Hope it helps.
